title: Metamodernity
lyrics:
[00:33.98]Next to Hudson Yards
[00:36.23]It's crowded on the weekdays
[00:39.12]From April to May
[00:42.12]Parse apart a troubled heart from an E Train
[00:47.08]And sing about it in LA
[00:51.94]With clouds in the rearview
[00:54.35]You start humming along
[00:56.38]To the first verse
[00:58.34]Of your favorite song
[01:00.28]That you quote each day with the words all wrong
[01:04.66]So call me when the world looks bleak
[01:08.67]I love you but it's hard to believe
[01:12.59]With every day we'll start to see
[01:16.53]The rest is metamodernity
[01:36.90]With agrestic charm
[01:39.13]It's humid in the midwest
[01:42.08]From June to July
[01:45.28]All beneath a pinkish sky from the wildfires
[01:49.95]Which mantle the horizon line
[01:59.28]From the outset
[02:01.28]It's been hard to tell
[02:03.30]Why I'd feel this down
[02:05.28]When it all bodes well
[02:07.61]So call me when the world looks bleak
[02:11.62]I love you but it's hard to believe
[02:15.54]With every day we'll start to see
[02:19.47]The rest is metamodernity
